definitions.explanation: A slender, silvery saltwater fish that is one of the most iconic foods of autumn in Japan. Typically grilled whole with salt and eaten with grated daikon radish and soy sauce.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{秋刀魚|さんま}が{食|た}べたくなる。
examples.english: When autumn comes, I start craving saury.

examples.japanese: {塩焼|しおや}きの{秋刀魚|さんま}に{大根|だいこん}おろしを{添|そ}える。
examples.english: To serve salt-grilled saury with grated daikon.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}は{秋刀魚|さんま}の{漁獲量|ぎょかくりょう}が{減|へ}っていて、{値段|ねだん}が{高|たか}くなっている。
examples.english: In recent years, the saury catch has been declining, and the price has been rising.

notes:
USAGE:
Also commonly written in katakana as サンマ or hiragana as さんま. The kanji {秋刀魚|さんま} is an ateji (phonetic kanji spelling), with the characters meaning "autumn sword fish" — a poetic description of its slender shape and its season.

One of the most representative foods of Japanese autumn. {秋刀魚|さんま}の{塩焼|しおや}き (salt-grilled saury) is a staple home-cooked dish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋刀魚|さんま}の{塩焼|しおや}き: salt-grilled saury
- {秋刀魚|さんま}を{焼|や}く: to grill saury
- {秋刀魚|さんま}の{刺身|さしみ}: saury sashimi
- {秋刀魚|さんま}{漁|りょう}: saury fishing
